# Mandarin Hero

> An app for learning the everyday Mandarin Chinese people actually speak, made by Nuli (https://nuli.nl/), an independent app studio in the Netherlands.

Mandarin Hero is an iPhone and Android app for learning colloquial, everyday spoken Mandarin Chinese: the language people actually speak, not textbook Chinese. It's made for people serious about learning Chinese who want to hold real conversations, from complete beginners up. It doesn't promise fluency in weeks: no nonsense, no fluff, it makes every hour of study count by going straight to what builds real proficiency.

- 35 lessons, each a real-life situation (ordering food, a taxi, the airport, the doctor, chatting on WeChat, KTV): first its key words, then its handy phrases, then the conversation as people really have it, then a role-play where you say your part out loud.
- Spaced repetition: every word and phrase comes back right before you'd forget it.
- Natural example sentences with the particles natives use (啊, 呢, 吧, 嘛), audio on every line, tone practice from day one, and a memory story for every character.
- All HSK 1–6 vocabulary (about 5,000 words) for extra practice.
- The whole app is in English or Dutch.
- Free to start, no ads: the first lessons, HSK 1 and all reviews. Hero Pro unlocks every lesson and HSK 2–6.
